metadata.title: Padelboard — Free padel scoreboard for streamers
metadata.description: Free-forever streaming scoreboard for padel matches. OBS browser-source overlay with golden point, super-tiebreak, and phone-based control.

manifesto.metaDescription: Every match deserves a spotlight. Why Padelboard is a free Padel Labs initiative making professional-looking padel streams accessible to everyone.
manifesto.heroLead:
A Friday-night friendly. A first tournament. A club final.

If it matters on court, it deserves to look the part on screen.
manifesto.beliefParagraphOne: Padel is full of moments worth sharing. The impossible recovery. The deciding point. The pair who finally win their first match together.
manifesto.beliefParagraphTwo: We believe a professional-looking broadcast should be within reach of anyone who wants to share those moments. A player. A friend. A coach. A club.
manifesto.beliefEmphasis:
You bring the match.

We help you bring it to the world.
manifesto.missionCardOneBody: You should be thinking about the next point, not stitching together a pile of tools. A scoreboard, your match, and a simpler way to get it on screen.
manifesto.missionCardTwoBody: Clear scores. Your club’s colors. A broadcast you’re proud to share. Professional presentation should belong to every court, whatever the size of the event.
manifesto.missionCardThreeBody: Padelboard is a free initiative because the cost of a scoreboard shouldn’t stand between a match and its audience. More people should get to press play.
manifesto.impactTitle:
More matches seen.

More people hooked.

More room for padel to grow.
manifesto.impactBody: We want to be a catalyst. To help clubs reach their communities, players share their stories, and new fans discover the game. Making it easier to broadcast is our way of helping padel take its next step.
manifesto.labsTitle:
A little project.

A big love for padel.
manifesto.labsParagraphOne: Padelboard is a <link>Padel Labs project ↗</link>. It’s our contribution to a sport we love: practical technology that helps more people take part.
manifesto.labsParagraphTwo: We’re building for the people beside the court. And we want to keep learning from them. Every match you share, every idea, every bit of feedback helps shape what comes next.
manifesto.inviteFootnote: Free to get started. Made for the love of the game.

home.heroLead: Create beautiful, real-time padel scoreboards<brDesktop></brDesktop> for OBS, StreamYard or your favorite streaming<brDesktop></brDesktop> software. No account needed to try.
home.featureScoringBody: Tap a point. Your stream keeps up.

home.featureYoursBody: Your players, your colors, your match.
home.featureNoInstallBody: One browser. All you need to get going.
home.stepOneBody: Add your players, choose a color, and set the rules. See your board change as you go.
home.stepTwoBody: Try the scoring controls for free. Golden point, deuce, and tiebreaks are taken care of.
home.stepThreeBody: Sign in to publish, copy your overlay link, and add it as a browser source. You’re on.
home.examplesTitle:
A little more

you. A lot more

match day.
home.examplesLead:
From the Friday-night friendly to the club final.

There’s a board with your name on it.
home.faqAccountA: You can customize a board and try the scoring controls without an account. Sign in when you’re ready to publish a live board and share its overlay.
home.faqStreamQ: How does it work with my stream?
home.faqStreamA: Once your board is published, add its overlay URL as a browser source in your streaming software. Control the match from your browser while the overlay shows the score.
home.faqScoringA: Yes. Star Point, golden point, advantage, set tiebreaks, and a deciding super-tiebreak are built in. Choose your match format during setup.
home.faqUndoQ: Can I fix an accidental point?
home.faqUndoA: Of course. Tap Undo to go back a point. Try it in the preview — no pressure.

help.metaDescription: Your first stream, one easy step at a time. Learn Padelboard Studio, OBS overlays and phone controls.
help.heroLead: Pick your setup. We’ll take it point by point.
help.studioTabBody: Camera + scoreboard. All in your browser.
help.obsTabBody: Add a live scoreboard to your OBS scene.
help.packItemMatch: A saved match in your Padelboard account.
help.studioPackItemCamera: A connected camera and a desktop browser with camera access.
help.obsPackItemInstall: OBS Studio installed, with a scene and your camera already set up.
help.studioPackItemService: A streaming service that accepts screen or browser-tab sharing.
help.obsPackItemConnection: An internet connection for live scoreboard updates.
help.packItemPhone: Optional: your phone, signed in to the same account.
help.packFootnote: New here? Create your match, choose a look and save it first.
help.studioStepOneBody: Open a match from My matches. In the Live tab, leave the output on Padelboard Studio. This is your camera preview and scoring desk in one place.
help.studioStepOneShotAlt: Studio selected in the output switch, with camera preview and scoring controls
help.studioStepOneShotCaption: Studio before the camera starts. Your match stays in the same workspace.
help.studioStepTwoBody: Under Set the scene → Video source, choose Camera, then press Start camera and allow camera access. Drag the scoreboard into place and use Whole scoreboard size to scale the entire board.
help.studioStepTwoTip: Showing a replay or a remote broadcast? Choose Screen / window / tab as your video source, then press Choose screen. Open the video on this computer and select its tab or window in the browser picker. Keep it playing and tap points as you watch. Avoid capturing the Studio itself. Screen capture supplies video only; configure the original audio in your streaming service. This option needs a supported desktop browser.
help.studioStepTwoLook: Want a different look? Edit board lets you adjust the design. Press Save scoreboard to apply it.
help.studioStepTwoShotAlt: Camera selector, Start camera button, scoreboard position and size, and clean view controls
help.studioStepTwoShotCaption: Camera, position and size live together. Clean view becomes available when the camera is ready.
help.studioStepThreeTitle: Give your audience the clean view.
help.studioStepThreeBody: In your streaming service, choose screen or tab sharing and select the Padelboard tab. Back in Studio, press Clean view to share to show the camera and scoreboard without the controls.
help.studioStepThreeTip: A little audio check. Choose your microphone in the streaming service. Studio supplies the camera picture and scoreboard; it does not broadcast directly to YouTube or another platform, or capture your microphone.
help.studioStepThreeReturn: Press Esc or double-click the video to return to your controls. Keep this tab open while sharing.
help.obsStepOneBody: Open your match and stay on the Live tab. Turn on the OBS switch, then press Copy overlay link. You can tick Remember my choice to keep OBS as your preference on this browser.
help.obsStepOneShotAlt: OBS output selected, live scoreboard preview and Copy overlay link button
help.obsStepOneShotCaption: Demo match shown. Copy the link from your own match, not the example URL in this screenshot.
help.obsStepTwoBody: In OBS, open the scene you use for the match. Under Sources, click +, choose Browser, and name it “Padelboard”. Leave Local file off and paste your overlay link into URL.
help.obsStepTwoMenuShotAlt: OBS add-source menu with Browser near the top
help.obsStepTwoMenuShotCaption: In OBS: Sources → + → Browser. Choose Browser near the top; the official example highlights Game Capture. Name your new source Padelboard.
help.obsStepTwoPropertiesShotAlt: OBS Browser Source properties showing Local file, URL, Width, Height and Custom CSS
help.obsStepTwoPropertiesShotCaption: This official screenshot shows OBS defaults. Replace its example URL with your Padelboard overlay link and change 800 × 600 to 1920 × 1080. The appearance may vary by OBS version.
help.obsStepTwoCss: Keep the default transparent-background CSS. Click OK. Use the overlay URL, which contains /overlay/, rather than your match-control URL.
help.obsStepThreeBody: In the OBS Sources list, move Padelboard above your camera source so the scoreboard appears over the video. If the source is cropped or offset, use Transform → Fit to Screen as a starting point, then adjust its size and position to suit your scene.
help.obsStepThreeTip: One quick check before going live. Confirm the board is visible over the camera and the player names are readable. OBS handles your camera, microphone, recording and broadcast.
help.obsStepThreeShotAlt: OBS Controls dock with Start Streaming, Start Recording, Studio Mode and Settings
help.obsStepThreeShotCaption: Use Start Recording for a short test. Once your streaming destination is configured in OBS and everything looks right, Start Streaming goes live.
help.obsStepThreeDesk: Keep Padelboard open as your scoring desk. The overlay follows your saved score and design changes automatically.
help.stepFourBody: Choose the server under Change serving player, then press Start match when play begins. Tap + Point for the pair who won the point. Made a mistake? Use Undo last point.
help.stepFourFocus: Focus mode clears away setup controls. You can pause or resume the match clock and toggle Show scoreboard or Show match time whenever you need.
help.stepFourShotAlt: Focus mode with scoring buttons, serving player selector and scoreboard and match-time visibility controls
help.stepFourShotCaption: Focus mode, ready for the first serve. Scoring unlocks when you start the match.
help.stepFourTip: Prefer scoring courtside? Open Control from phone, scan the QR code and sign in to the same account on your phone. Keep the broadcast running on your computer. Your phone becomes the simple scoring remote.
help.stepFiveBody: Use Match options → End match and confirm when play is finished. Open Insights for the match summary, or find the match later in My matches → History.
help.stepFiveTiming: Timing insights use the intervals between your scoring taps. They can include the time between rallies, so they are not exact rally durations.
help.faqCameraQuestion: My camera won’t appear in Studio.
help.faqCameraAnswer: Check the browser’s camera permission for Padelboard, connect your camera and select it under Set the scene. Close other apps using it, then retry Start camera. Clean view stays disabled until the camera is ready.
help.faqOverlayQuestion: I can’t see the scoreboard in OBS.
help.faqOverlayAnswer: Check that your Browser Source uses the overlay link from the correct match, is visible, and sits above your camera. In Padelboard, turn on Show scoreboard on screen. If needed, open the source’s properties in OBS and use Refresh cache of current page.
help.faqPhoneQuestion: Can I use my phone while the computer streams?
help.faqPhoneAnswer: Yes. Use Control from phone and sign in as the match owner. Keep the computer, broadcast and internet connection running. The remote is for scores, serving, the clock and overlay visibility; full design setup stays in the match workspace.
